title: Is this right for me?
lead: Four small questions, no right answers and nothing recorded. Your answers land you on the service that fits what you described — a real page you can read, share, or come back to.
routingLabel: Taking you to the page that fits…
disclaimer: A signpost, not a diagnosis: this check only helps you choose a starting point, and it is no substitute for a proper conversation.
fallbackLabel: If nothing quite fits, email me a few lines about what is going on and I will point you somewhere good — even if it is not here
noscript: The check needs JavaScript, which is switched off in your browser. No matter — the three services below describe exactly who each one is for.

questions.prompt: Who would the sessions be for?
What feels most present right now?

options.label: Worry, low mood, or feeling stuck
Distance or friction with a partner
A young person who seems to be struggling

questions.prompt: What are you hoping sessions would give you?

options.label: Room to understand myself and shift old patterns
Better conversations with someone I love
Steady support for my teen — and for me as a parent

questions.prompt: If a good friend summed it up, they might say…

options.label: “You have been carrying too much on your own.”
“You are worried sick about your kid.”
